blurb: A museum of Africa and its peoples around the world, first imagined in 1966 and opened in 2018.

facts.t: Senegal's first president, the poet Léopold Sédar Senghor, proposed a museum of Black civilisations at the World Festival of Black Arts in Dakar in 1966. It opened 52 years later, in 2018, in a round building inspired by the houses of southern Senegal.
